description: Write data to database tables with multiple write modes and field mapping

data_input.info: Data to write to the target table

table_selector.info: Select the table to write data to

field_mappings.info: Map source fields to target table columns with update options
field_mappings.is_key_field_desc: Check if this field is a key field for upsert mode
field_mappings.null_value_desc: Default value when source field is null or empty

preview_table.info: Preview existing data in the target table (first 100 rows)

write_mode.info: How to write data: batch_insert (fast, no duplicate check), upsert (insert/update based on keys), replace (truncate + insert), append (simple insert)

clear_table_first.info: Truncate the target table before writing data

auto_create_table.info: Automatically create the table if it does not exist

batch_size.info: Number of records to write per batch (1-100000)

enable_transaction.info: Wrap write operations in a database transaction (commit on success, rollback on error)

isolation_level.info: Database transaction isolation level (only applies when transaction is enabled)

escape_char.info: Character to escape table/column names (e.g., ` for MySQL, " for PostgreSQL). Leave empty for no escaping.

status.no_input_data: No input data available for schema analysis
status.no_fields_to_map: No field mappings available to auto-map
status.no_target_fields: No target fields available. Please select a table first.

errors.no_data: No data to write. Please provide input data.
errors.no_datasource: No datasource selected. Please select a datasource.
errors.no_table: No table selected. Please select a target table.
errors.no_datasource_or_table: Please select both datasource and table before preview
errors.no_field_mappings: No field mappings configured. Please use 'Analyze Schema' button.
errors.no_key_fields: No key fields selected. Upsert mode requires at least one key field.
errors.empty_dataframe: Data conversion resulted in empty DataFrame
errors.no_graph_data: Cannot retrieve flow graph data. Please ensure the component is connected to upstream nodes
